title: Container stats API panics on a container with a memory reservation and no memory limit
body:
### Issue Description

Create a container with a memory reservation and no memory limit, then ask the API for its stats. The request never succeeds.

No stats are ever returned. The body is an error, and the service logs a warning carrying a full goroutine dump  for each request. It fails on every request for the life of the container.
The HTTP status says 200. The header is flushed before the failure, so the wire status is success while the body reports its own "response":500.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

1. podman run -d --name t --memory-reservation 10m --entrypoint sleep alpine 60
2. curl -s --unix-socket /run/podman/podman.sock 'http://d/v1.41/containers/t/stats?stream=false'


### Describe the results you received

Describe the results you received

http response:

```{"cause":"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference","message":"runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference","response":500}```

And the panic from the service logs
